statement: The cellar door at Paradigm Hill is open every Saturday and Sunday from midday to 5pm.
note: Unsupported, and disputed by the operator. No record was changed on the strength of a dispute: the operator publishes no hours at all, so a source read can say the record is wrong without saying what is right. The record also contradicts itself, because its own tastingNote limits walk-in access to the first weekend of each month while the openingHours array beside it asserts every weekend and is the field that reaches JSON-LD. An editor has to ask the operator. Authored by hand for the PI-005 Stage 2 venue pilot. Sources were read on 2026-09-13; see ops/reports/claims/2026-09-13-pilot-venues.md.
